fr.R: Nous sommes restés plusieurs jours à Philippes.

sw.L: Na tulikuwa katika mji huu tukikaa siku kadhaa.
sw.B: Tulikaa katika mji ule siku kadhaa.
sw.R: Tulikaa Filipi kwa siku kadhaa.

vi.L: Chúng tôi ở lại thành ấy ít ngày.
vi.B: Chúng tôi ở lại thành ấy ít ngày.
vi.R: Chúng tôi ở lại Phi-líp ít ngày.

ko.L: 그리고 우리는 이 도시에서 며칠 동안 지내고 있었다.
ko.B: 우리는 그 도시에서 며칠을 지냈다.
ko.R: 우리는 빌립보에서 며칠 동안 머물렀다.

pt.L: E estávamos nesta cidade, passando alguns dias.
pt.B: Passamos alguns dias naquela cidade.
pt.R: Ficamos em Filipos por vários dias.

am.L: በዚህችም ከተማ አንዳንድ ቀናት እንቀመጥ ነበር።
am.B: በዚያች ከተማ ጥቂት ቀናት ቆየን።
am.R: በፊልጵስዩስ ጥቂት ቀናት ቆየን።

hi.L: और हम उस नगर में कुछ दिन रहे।
hi.B: हमने उस नगर में कई दिन बिताए।
hi.R: हम फिलिप्पी में कई दिन रहे।

ru.L: Были же мы в этом городе, проводя некоторые дни.
ru.B: В этом городе мы провели несколько дней.
ru.R: Мы прожили в Филиппах несколько дней.

uk.L: І ми пробули в цьому місті кілька днів.
uk.B: У тому місті ми провели кілька днів.
uk.R: Ми пробули у Філіппах кілька днів.

ja.L: そしてわたしたちは、この町に何日か滞在していた。
ja.B: わたしたちはその町で数日を過ごした。
ja.R: わたしたちは、フィリピに何日か滞在しました。

decisions.choice: were staying: a stay of some days before the Sabbath of 16:13
decisions.reason: The words are vague. The stay before the first Sabbath was short; the whole stay was longer (16:18).

decisions.choice: Philippi
decisions.reason: Readable names the city.

source.text: τῇ τε ἡμέρᾳ τῶν σαββάτων ἐξήλθομεν ἔξω τῆς πύλης παρὰ ποταμὸν οὗ ἐνομίζομεν προσευχὴν εἶναι, καὶ καθίσαντες ἐλαλοῦμεν ταῖς συνελθούσαις γυναιξίν.

records.literal_gloss: On the and day of the Sabbaths we went forth outside the gate beside a river where we were supposing a place of prayer to be, and having sat down we were speaking to the having come together women.

en.L: And on the Sabbath day we went out outside the gate beside a river, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and sitting down, we were speaking to the women who had come together.
en.B: On the Sabbath day we went out beyond the gate, beside a river, where we thought there might be a place of prayer. We took a seat and spoke to the women who had come together.
en.R: On the Sabbath day we went out of the city gate to the river. We thought Jewish people might meet there to pray. We sat down and talked to the women who had come there.

es.L: Y el día sábado salimos fuera de la puerta, junto a un río, donde suponíamos que había un lugar de oración; y sentándonos, hablábamos a las mujeres que se habían reunido.
es.B: El sábado salimos más allá de la puerta, junto a un río, donde pensábamos que habría un lugar de oración. Nos sentamos y hablamos a las mujeres que se habían reunido.
es.R: El sábado salimos por la puerta de la ciudad y fuimos al río. Pensábamos que tal vez allí se reunían judíos para orar. Nos sentamos y hablamos con las mujeres que habían llegado.

fr.L: Et le jour du sabbat, nous sortîmes hors de la porte, au bord d’une rivière, où nous pensions qu’il y avait un lieu de prière, et nous étant assis, nous parlions aux femmes qui s’étaient réunies.
fr.B: Le jour du sabbat, nous sortîmes de la ville par la porte et allâmes au bord d’une rivière, où nous pensions trouver un lieu de prière. Nous nous assîmes et parlâmes aux femmes qui s’y étaient rassemblées.
fr.R: Le jour du sabbat, nous sommes sortis par la porte de la ville et nous sommes allés au bord de la rivière. Nous pensions que des Juifs se réunissaient peut-être là pour prier. Nous nous sommes assis et nous avons parlé avec les femmes qui étaient venues.

sw.L: Na siku ya Sabato tulitoka nje ya lango kando ya mto, ambapo tulidhani kuna mahali pa maombi; na tukiketi, tulikuwa tukizungumza na wanawake waliokusanyika.
sw.B: Siku ya Sabato tulitoka nje ya lango, tukaenda kando ya mto, ambapo tulidhani pangekuwa na mahali pa maombi. Tukaketi, tukazungumza na wanawake waliokuwa wamekusanyika huko.
sw.R: Siku ya Sabato tulitoka nje ya lango la mji, tukaenda mtoni. Tulidhani labda Wayahudi walikutana huko kuomba. Tukaketi, tukazungumza na wanawake waliokuwa wamefika pale.

vi.L: Vào ngày Sa-bát, chúng tôi ra ngoài cổng thành, đến bên một bờ sông, nơi chúng tôi nghĩ là có chỗ cầu nguyện; và ngồi xuống, chúng tôi nói chuyện với những phụ nữ đã nhóm lại đó.
vi.B: Vào ngày Sa-bát, chúng tôi ra ngoài cổng thành, đến bờ sông, nơi chúng tôi nghĩ có thể có chỗ cầu nguyện. Chúng tôi ngồi xuống và nói chuyện với những phụ nữ đã nhóm lại tại đó.
vi.R: Vào ngày Sa-bát, chúng tôi ra khỏi cổng thành và đi đến bờ sông. Chúng tôi nghĩ có thể người Do Thái nhóm lại ở đó để cầu nguyện. Chúng tôi ngồi xuống và nói chuyện với những phụ nữ đã đến đó.

ko.L: 그리고 안식일에 우리는 성문 밖으로 나가 강가로 갔다. 그곳에 기도하는 곳이 있으리라고 생각했기 때문이다. 그리고 앉아서 모여든 여자들에게 말하고 있었다.
ko.B: 안식일에 우리는 성문 밖으로 나가 강가로 갔다. 그곳에 기도하는 곳이 있을 것이라고 생각했기 때문이다. 우리는 그곳에 앉아서 모여 있는 여자들에게 말씀을 전했다.
ko.R: 안식일에 우리는 성문 밖으로 나가 강가로 갔다. 유대 사람들이 그곳에 모여 기도할 것이라고 생각했기 때문이다. 우리는 그곳에 앉아서, 모여 있던 여자들과 이야기를 나누었다.

pt.L: E no dia de sábado saímos para fora da porta, junto a um rio, onde supúnhamos haver um lugar de oração, e, sentando-nos, falávamos às mulheres que se tinham reunido.
pt.B: No sábado, saímos pela porta da cidade e fomos até a beira de um rio, onde pensávamos que haveria um lugar de oração. Nós nos sentamos e falamos às mulheres que tinham se reunido ali.
pt.R: No sábado, saímos pelo portão da cidade e fomos até o rio. Achávamos que os judeus talvez se reunissem ali para orar. Nós nos sentamos e conversamos com as mulheres que tinham ido até lá.

am.L: በሰንበትም ቀን የጸሎት ስፍራ በዚያ ያለ መስሎን ከበሩ ውጭ ወደ ወንዝ አጠገብ ወጣን፤ ተቀምጠንም ለተሰበሰቡት ሴቶች እንናገር ነበር።
am.B: በሰንበት ቀን የጸሎት ስፍራ ሳይኖር አይቀርም ብለን ከከተማዪቱ በር ወጥተን ወደ ወንዝ ዳር ሄድን። በዚያም ተቀምጠን ለተሰበሰቡት ሴቶች ተናገርን።
am.R: በሰንበት ቀን ከከተማዪቱ በር ወጥተን ወደ ወንዙ ሄድን። አይሁድ ለመጸለይ በዚያ ይሰበሰቡ ይሆናል ብለን አሰብን። ተቀምጠንም እዚያ ለመጡት ሴቶች ተናገርን።

hi.L: और सब्त के दिन हम फाटक के बाहर नदी के किनारे गए, जहाँ हमने समझा कि प्रार्थना का स्थान है, और बैठकर उन स्त्रियों से बातें करने लगे जो इकट्ठी हुई थीं।
hi.B: सब्त के दिन हम फाटक के बाहर नदी के किनारे गए, जहाँ हमें लगा कि प्रार्थना करने की जगह होगी। हम बैठ गए और उन स्त्रियों से बातें करने लगे जो वहाँ इकट्ठी हुई थीं।
hi.R: सब्त के दिन हम शहर के फाटक से बाहर नदी के पास गए। हमने सोचा कि शायद यहूदी लोग वहाँ प्रार्थना करने के लिए मिलते होंगे। हम बैठ गए और वहाँ आई स्त्रियों से बातें करने लगे।

ru.L: В день же субботний мы вышли за ворота к реке, где, как мы думали, было место молитвы, и, сев, говорили собравшимся женщинам.
ru.B: В субботу мы вышли за городские ворота к реке, где, как мы думали, было место для молитвы. Мы сели и стали говорить с собравшимися там женщинами.
ru.R: В субботу мы вышли из города через ворота и пошли к реке. Мы думали, что иудеи, может быть, собираются там для молитвы. Мы сели и стали говорить с женщинами, которые туда пришли.

uk.L: А в день суботній ми вийшли за браму до річки, де, як ми думали, було місце молитви, і, сівши, говорили до жінок, що зійшлися.
uk.B: У суботу ми вийшли за міську браму до річки, де, як ми думали, могло бути місце молитви. Ми сіли й говорили з жінками, які там зібралися.
uk.R: У суботу ми вийшли за міську браму до річки. Ми думали, що юдеї можуть збиратися там на молитву. Ми сіли й розмовляли з жінками, які туди прийшли.

ja.L: そして安息日に、わたしたちは門の外に出て川のほとりに[行った]。そこに祈りの場所があると思ったからである。そして座って、集まって来た女性たちに語っていた。
ja.B: 安息日に、わたしたちは町の門を出て、川のほとりに行った。そこに祈りの場所があるだろうと思ったのである。そして座って、集まって来た女性たちに話をした。
ja.R: 安息日に、わたしたちは町の門を出て、川のほとりへ行きました。ユダヤ人がそこに集まって祈っているかもしれないと思ったのです。わたしたちは座って、そこに集まって来た女の人たちに話をしました。

decisions.choice: a place of prayer: a place where Jews met for prayer
decisions.reason: The word means prayer, and was used for a Jewish meeting place, often a building (Josephus, and inscriptions from Egypt). Here it may be an open place by the water. No synagogue is named at Philippi, perhaps because few Jews lived there; only women are mentioned.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "where we supposed there was a place of prayer"
decisions.reason: Manuscripts differ between a form meaning "we supposed" and one meaning "it was customary". The SBLGNT reads the first. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: the day of the Sabbaths: the Sabbath day
decisions.reason: The plural is a usual way of naming the Sabbath (Luke 4:16).

decisions.choice: sitting down: the posture of a teacher
decisions.reason: Teachers sat to teach in the synagogue (Luke 4:20).

decisions.choice: Jewish people might meet there to pray
alternatives: there was a place of prayer
decisions.reason: Readable says what a place of prayer was, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: "chỗ cầu nguyện" for the place of prayer
decisions.reason: A place where Jews met for prayer (meaning decision), which might be an open place by the river rather than a building, so "chỗ" (place) rather than "nhà".

source.text: καί τις γυνὴ ὀνόματι Λυδία, πορφυρόπωλις πόλεως Θυατείρων σεβομένη τὸν θεόν, ἤκουεν, ἧς ὁ κύριος διήνοιξεν τὴν καρδίαν προσέχειν τοῖς λαλουμένοις ὑπὸ τοῦ Παύλου.

records.literal_gloss: And a certain woman by name Lydia, a seller of purple of a city of Thyatira, worshiping the God, was listening, of whom the Lord opened the heart to pay attention to the things being spoken by the Paul.

en.L: And a certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple [cloth] from the city of Thyatira, who worshiped God, was listening; the Lord opened her heart to pay attention to the things spoken by Paul.
en.B: A woman named Lydia was listening, a dealer in purple cloth from the city of Thyatira, who worshiped God. The Lord opened her heart to heed what Paul was saying.
en.R: A woman named Lydia was there listening. She was from the city of Thyatira, and she sold costly purple cloth. She was not a Jew, but she worshiped the God of Israel. The Lord opened her heart, so that she paid close attention to what Paul said.

es.L: Y una mujer llamada Lidia, vendedora de púrpura de la ciudad de Tiatira, que adoraba a Dios, escuchaba; el Señor le abrió el corazón para que atendiera a lo que Pablo decía.
es.B: Escuchaba también una mujer llamada Lidia, comerciante en telas de púrpura, de la ciudad de Tiatira, que adoraba a Dios. El Señor le abrió el corazón para que acogiera lo que Pablo decía.
es.R: Una mujer llamada Lidia estaba allí escuchando. Era de la ciudad de Tiatira y vendía telas de púrpura, que eran muy caras. No era judía, pero adoraba al Dios de Israel. El Señor le abrió el corazón, y ella prestó mucha atención a lo que Pablo decía.

fr.L: Et une femme nommée Lydie, marchande de pourpre, de la ville de Thyatire, qui adorait Dieu, écoutait ; le Seigneur lui ouvrit le cœur pour qu’elle soit attentive à ce que disait Paul.
fr.B: Une femme appelée Lydie écoutait. Elle vendait des étoffes de pourpre et venait de la ville de Thyatire ; elle adorait Dieu. Le Seigneur lui ouvrit le cœur pour qu’elle accueille ce que disait Paul.
fr.R: Une femme appelée Lydie était là et écoutait. Elle venait de la ville de Thyatire et vendait de la pourpre, un tissu rouge violet qui coûtait cher. Elle n’était pas juive, mais elle adorait le Dieu d’Israël. Le Seigneur lui a ouvert le cœur, et elle a écouté très attentivement ce que Paul disait.

sw.L: Na mwanamke mmoja aitwaye Lidia, mwuzaji wa [nguo za] zambarau wa mji wa Thiatira, aliyekuwa akimwabudu Mungu, alikuwa akisikiliza; Bwana akaufungua moyo wake ayatilie maanani yaliyokuwa yakisemwa na Paulo.
sw.B: Mwanamke mmoja aitwaye Lidia alikuwa akisikiliza; alikuwa mfanyabiashara wa nguo za zambarau kutoka mji wa Thiatira, naye alimwabudu Mungu. Bwana aliufungua moyo wake ayatilie maanani maneno ya Paulo.
sw.R: Mwanamke mmoja aitwaye Lidia alikuwa pale akisikiliza. Alitoka mji wa Thiatira, na aliuza nguo za zambarau zenye bei kubwa. Hakuwa Myahudi, lakini alimwabudu Mungu wa Israeli. Bwana aliufungua moyo wake, akasikiliza kwa makini yale aliyosema Paulo.

vi.L: Và có một phụ nữ tên là Ly-đi, buôn bán vải điều, người thành Thi-a-ti-rơ, là người thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời, đang nghe; Chúa mở lòng bà để chú ý đến những lời Phao-lô nói.
vi.B: Có một phụ nữ tên là Ly-đi đang lắng nghe. Bà là người buôn vải điều, quê ở thành Thi-a-ti-rơ, và là người thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời. Chúa mở lòng bà để bà chăm chú nghe những lời Phao-lô nói.
vi.R: Có một phụ nữ tên là Ly-đi đang ngồi nghe ở đó. Bà đến từ thành Thi-a-ti-rơ, và bà buôn bán vải màu tím đắt tiền. Bà không phải là người Do Thái, nhưng bà thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời của dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Chúa mở lòng bà, nên bà chăm chú nghe những điều Phao-lô nói.

ko.L: 그리고 두아디라 도시 출신으로 자색 옷감 장수이며 하나님을 경외하는 루디아라는 어떤 여자가 듣고 있었다. 주님께서 그 여자의 마음을 열어 바울이 하는 말에 귀를 기울이게 하셨다.
ko.B: 그 가운데 루디아라는 여자가 듣고 있었다. 그는 두아디라 시에서 온 자색 옷감 장수로, 하나님을 경외하는 사람이었다. 주님께서 그의 마음을 여셔서, 바울이 하는 말을 마음에 새기게 하셨다.
ko.R: 그곳에서 루디아라는 여자가 말씀을 듣고 있었다. 그는 두아디라라는 도시에서 왔고, 값비싼 자주색 옷감을 파는 사람이었다. 그는 유대 사람이 아니었지만 이스라엘의 하나님을 섬겼다. 주님께서 루디아의 마음을 열어 주셔서, 그는 바울의 말을 귀 기울여 들었다.

pt.L: E uma certa mulher chamada Lídia, vendedora de [tecido de] púrpura da cidade de Tiatira, que adorava a Deus, ouvia; o Senhor abriu o coração dela para atender às coisas ditas por Paulo.
pt.B: Uma mulher chamada Lídia estava ouvindo. Era comerciante de tecido de púrpura, da cidade de Tiatira, e adorava a Deus. O Senhor abriu o coração dela para que desse atenção ao que Paulo dizia.
pt.R: Uma mulher chamada Lídia estava ali ouvindo. Ela era da cidade de Tiatira e vendia tecido de púrpura, que era muito caro. Ela não era judia, mas adorava o Deus de Israel. O Senhor abriu o coração dela, e ela prestou muita atenção ao que Paulo dizia.

am.L: ከትያጥሮን ከተማ የሆነች የሐምራዊ [ልብስ] ሻጭ፣ እግዚአብሔርን የምታመልክ ልድያ የምትባል አንዲት ሴትም ትሰማ ነበር፤ ጳውሎስ የሚናገረውንም ልብ ብላ እንድትሰማ ጌታ ልብዋን ከፈተላት።
am.B: ልድያ የምትባል አንዲት ሴት ትሰማ ነበር፤ እርሷም ከትያጥሮን ከተማ የመጣች የሐምራዊ ልብስ ነጋዴ ስትሆን እግዚአብሔርን የምታመልክ ነበረች። ጌታም ጳውሎስ የሚናገረውን እንድትቀበል ልብዋን ከፈተላት።
am.R: በዚያም ልድያ የምትባል አንዲት ሴት ታዳምጥ ነበር። እርሷ ከትያጥሮን ከተማ የመጣች ነበረች፤ ውድ የሆነ ሐምራዊ ልብስ ትሸጥ ነበር። አይሁዳዊት አልነበረችም፤ ነገር ግን የእስራኤልን አምላክ ታመልክ ነበር። ጌታ ልብዋን ከፈተላት፤ ስለዚህም ጳውሎስ የሚናገረውን በጥሞና አዳመጠች።

hi.L: और लुदिया नाम की एक स्त्री, जो थुआतीरा नगर की बैंजनी [कपड़े] बेचनेवाली और परमेश्वर की आराधना करनेवाली थी, सुन रही थी; प्रभु ने उसका मन खोल दिया कि वह पौलुस की कही हुई बातों पर ध्यान दे।
hi.B: लुदिया नाम की एक स्त्री सुन रही थी। वह थुआतीरा नगर की थी, बैंजनी कपड़े का व्यापार करती थी और परमेश्वर की आराधना करती थी। प्रभु ने उसका मन खोल दिया कि वह पौलुस की बातों को माने।
hi.R: वहाँ लुदिया नाम की एक स्त्री सुन रही थी। वह थुआतीरा शहर की थी और क़ीमती बैंजनी कपड़ा बेचती थी। वह यहूदी नहीं थी, पर इस्राएल के परमेश्वर की आराधना करती थी। प्रभु ने उसका मन खोल दिया, ताकि वह पौलुस की बातों पर पूरा ध्यान दे।

ru.L: И некая женщина по имени Лидия, торговка пурпуром из города Фиатиры, почитающая Бога, слушала; Господь открыл ей сердце, чтобы внимать тому, что говорил Павел.
ru.B: Слушала и женщина по имени Лидия, торговка пурпурными тканями из города Фиатиры, которая почитала Бога. Господь открыл её сердце, и она приняла к сердцу то, что говорил Павел.
ru.R: Там слушала женщина по имени Лидия. Она была из города Фиатиры и продавала дорогие пурпурные ткани. Она не была иудейкой, но поклонялась Богу Израиля. Господь открыл её сердце, и она внимательно слушала, что говорил Павел.

uk.L: І слухала одна жінка на імʼя Лідія, продавчиня пурпуру з міста Тіятири, що шанувала Бога; Господь відкрив її серце, щоб вона уважала на те, що говорив Павло.
uk.B: Слухала й одна жінка на імʼя Лідія, торгівка пурпуровими тканинами з міста Тіятири, яка шанувала Бога. Господь відкрив її серце, щоб вона прийняла до серця те, що казав Павло.
uk.R: Там слухала жінка на імʼя Лідія. Вона була з міста Тіятири й продавала дорогу пурпурову тканину. Вона не була юдейкою, але поклонялася Богові Ізраїлю. Господь відкрив її серце, і вона уважно слухала те, що казав Павло.

ja.L: すると、ティアティラの町の紫布の商人で、神をあがめるリディアという名のある女性が聞いていた。主は彼女の心を開いて、パウロによって語られることに注意を向けさせられた。
ja.B: ティアティラの町の出身で紫布を商う、神をあがめるリディアという女性が、話を聞いていた。主は彼女の心を開いて、パウロの語ることに耳を傾けさせられた。
ja.R: そこで、リディアという女の人が話を聞いていました。リディアはティアティラという町の出身で、高価な紫の布を売っていました。リディアはユダヤ人ではありませんでしたが、イスラエルの神をあがめていました。主はリディアの心を開いてくださいました。それで彼女は、パウロの話をよく聞いて、心に受け入れました。

decisions.choice: a seller of purple: a trader in cloth dyed purple
decisions.reason: Purple dye was costly, and purple cloth was worn by the wealthy. Thyatira, in the region of Lydia in Asia, was known for its dyers, as inscriptions from the city show. A trader in such goods was likely a woman of some means; she has a house large enough for guests (16:15).

decisions.choice: who worshiped God: a Gentile who worshiped the God of Israel
decisions.reason: Luke uses this phrase and "those who fear God" for Gentiles who joined in Jewish worship without becoming Jews, like Cornelius (10:2) and some in Thessalonica and Corinth (17:4, 18:7). She was with the Jewish women at prayer.

decisions.choice: the Lord opened her heart: God's work brought her to faith
decisions.reason: The risen Jesus opened the minds of the disciples to understand the Scriptures (Luke 24:45). The heart stands for mind and will. Her listening was real, and the Lord made it fruitful. "The Lord" may be Jesus or God; Luke often leaves it open.

decisions.choice: pay attention to: take to heart and respond
decisions.reason: The verb means to give heed to something, and act on it, as in 8:6.

decisions.choice: she was not a Jew, but she worshiped the God of Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says what the phrase implied, as the meaning note explains. It is not certain that she was not Jewish.

decisions.choice: costly
decisions.reason: Readable says why purple cloth mattered.

decisions.choice: aliyekuwa akimwabudu Mungu (L); alimwabudu Mungu (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Greek says she worshiped God, and the meaning is a Gentile who worshiped the God of Israel (meaning decision m2). "Mcha Mungu" would be heard as "a devout person" in general; Readable says she was not a Jew, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "người thờ phượng Đức Chúa Trời" for a Gentile who worshiped God, here and in 17:4, 17:17, 18:7
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says she was a Gentile who worshiped the God of Israel; "thờ phượng" keeps the verb, and Readable says she was not a Jew, as the English Readable does. "kính sợ Đức Chúa Trời" is kept for the phrase "fear God" where Acts has it.

decisions.choice: "buôn bán vải điều" (L, B); "buôn bán vải màu tím đắt tiền" (R)
decisions.reason: "điều" is the deep red-purple of costly dyed cloth; Readable names the colour plainly.

decisions.choice: "하나님을 경외하는" (L, B); "유대 사람이 아니었지만 이스라엘의 하나님을 섬겼다" (R) for the God-fearers (sebomenoi, phoboumenoi ton theon), through Acts 15-28
decisions.reason: The words name a Gentile who worshiped the God of Israel (meaning decision, uncertain). "경외하다" is the established word for reverent fear of God, as in the Korean John 9:31; Readable says who such a person was, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "자색 옷감 장수" (L, B); "값비싼 자주색 옷감을 파는 사람" (R)
decisions.reason: The older phrase does not say that the trade was in cloth, which the meaning decision describes.

decisions.choice: que adorava a Deus
decisions.reason: Luke has two phrases for Gentiles who joined in Jewish worship (m2). Portuguese keeps them apart as the English does: "que adorava a Deus" here, "tementes a Deus" for the other phrase (10:2; 13:16), so a reader can tell which one the Greek has.

decisions.choice: "የሐምራዊ [ልብስ] ሻጭ" (L), "የሐምራዊ ልብስ ነጋዴ" (B), "ውድ የሆነ ሐምራዊ ልብስ ትሸጥ ነበር" (R)
decisions.reason: "ሐምራዊ" names the purple dye of the ancient cloth trade; Readable says it was costly, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "परमेश्वर की आराधना करनेवाली"
decisions.reason: Acts names Gentiles who worshiped the God of Israel (meaning decision m2) with two phrases. Hindi keeps "परमेश्वर की आराधना करनेवाले" for this one, and "परमेश्वर का भय माननेवाले" for those who fear God, so a reader can tell the Greek phrases apart.
The colour of the costly dyed cloth she traded in (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: "почитающая Бога"
decisions.reason: One phrase for the Gentiles who worshiped the God of Israel at the synagogue, used through Acts; Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: "що шанувала Бога" for *sebomenē*
decisions.reason: The brief's Acts term for *sebomenoi*; Readable explains that she was a Gentile who worshipped the God of Israel.

decisions.choice: "リディア", "ティアティラ"
decisions.reason: The names follow the Greek sounds by the same pattern as the other names in Japanese Acts; the older forms are not used.

decisions.choice: "神をあがめる" for one who worshiped God
decisions.reason: Japanese Acts uses "神をあがめる人々" for those called worshipers of God, and "神を畏れる人々" for God-fearers, so the two Greek phrases stay apart.

source.text: ὡς δὲ ἐβαπτίσθη καὶ ὁ οἶκος αὐτῆς, παρεκάλεσεν λέγουσα· Εἰ κεκρίκατέ με πιστὴν τῷ κυρίῳ εἶναι, εἰσελθόντες εἰς τὸν οἶκόν μου μένετε· καὶ παρεβιάσατο ἡμᾶς.

records.literal_gloss: When then she was baptized and the household of her, she urged saying, If you have judged me faithful to the Lord to be, having come into the house of me stay; and she prevailed upon us.

en.L: And when she and her household were baptized, she urged [us], saying, "If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house [and] stay." And she prevailed upon us.
en.B: After she and her household had been baptized, she pressed us to accept her offer: "If you are satisfied that I am faithful to the Lord, come into my home and stay." And she would not take no for an answer.
en.R: Lydia and the people in her home were baptized. Then she begged us, "If you agree that I truly trust in the Lord, come and stay in my house." She kept asking until we agreed.

es.L: Y cuando fue bautizada, y también su casa, [nos] rogó diciendo: «Si {{plural_you:han juzgado|habéis juzgado}} que yo soy fiel al Señor, {{plural_you:entren|entrad}} en mi casa [y] {{plural_you:quédense|quedaos}}». Y nos obligó [a aceptar].
es.B: Después de ser bautizada junto con los de su casa, nos insistió: «Si {{plural_you:consideran|consideráis}} que soy fiel al Señor, {{plural_you:vengan|venid}} a mi casa y {{plural_you:quédense|quedaos}} en ella». Y no nos dejó decir que no.
es.R: Lidia y los de su casa fueron bautizados. Después nos rogó: «Si {{plural_you:están|estáis}} de acuerdo en que de verdad confío en el Señor, {{plural_you:vengan a quedarse|venid a quedaros}} en mi casa». Insistió hasta que aceptamos.

fr.L: Et quand elle eut été baptisée, ainsi que sa maisonnée, elle [nous] pria, disant : « Si vous m’avez jugée fidèle au Seigneur, entrez dans ma maison [et] demeurez[-y]. » Et elle nous y contraignit.
fr.B: Après avoir été baptisée avec toute sa maisonnée, elle nous fit cette invitation pressante : « Si vous estimez que je suis fidèle au Seigneur, venez chez moi et restez-y. » Et elle insista tant que nous dûmes accepter.
fr.R: Lydie et les gens de sa maison ont été baptisés. Ensuite, elle nous a suppliés : « Si vous pensez que j’ai vraiment confiance dans le Seigneur, venez habiter chez moi. » Elle a tellement insisté que nous avons fini par accepter.

sw.L: Na alipobatizwa, yeye na nyumba yake, alitusihi akisema, "Ikiwa mmeamua kuwa mimi ni mwaminifu kwa Bwana, ingieni nyumbani mwangu mkae." Akatushurutisha.
sw.B: Alipokwisha kubatizwa pamoja na watu wa nyumbani mwake, alitusihi, akisema, "Ikiwa mmeridhika kwamba mimi ni mwaminifu kwa Bwana, njooni nyumbani kwangu mkae." Hakukubali tukatae.
sw.R: Lidia na watu wa nyumbani mwake walibatizwa. Kisha akatusihi, "Ikiwa mnakubali kwamba kweli ninamwamini Bwana, njooni mkae nyumbani kwangu." Aliendelea kutusihi mpaka tukakubali.

vi.L: Khi bà và cả nhà bà đã chịu báp-têm, bà nài xin rằng: "Nếu các ông xét thấy tôi là người trung tín với Chúa, xin hãy vào nhà tôi mà ở." Và bà ép chúng tôi [đến].
vi.B: Sau khi bà và cả nhà đã chịu báp-têm, bà tha thiết mời chúng tôi: "Nếu các ông thấy tôi thật lòng tin Chúa, xin mời vào nhà tôi ở lại." Bà cứ nài nỉ cho đến khi chúng tôi nhận lời.
vi.R: Ly-đi và những người trong nhà bà đều chịu báp-têm. Rồi bà nài xin chúng tôi: "Nếu các ông thấy tôi thật lòng tin cậy Chúa, xin mời đến ở nhà tôi." Bà cứ nài xin cho đến khi chúng tôi đồng ý.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자와 그 집안이 세례를 받은 뒤에, 그 여자는 간청하며 말했다. "여러분이 나를 주님께 신실한 사람으로 판단하신다면, 내 집에 들어오셔서 머무십시오." 그리고 그는 우리를 억지로 권하였다.
ko.B: 루디아와 그 집안 식구들이 세례를 받은 뒤에, 그는 우리에게 간청했다. "제가 주님을 믿는 신실한 사람이라고 여기신다면, 제 집에 오셔서 머물러 주십시오." 그리고 그는 우리가 그 청을 받아들일 때까지 졸랐다.
ko.R: 루디아와 그 집에 사는 사람들이 세례를 받았다. 그 뒤에 루디아가 우리에게 부탁했다. "제가 주님을 참으로 믿는다고 생각하신다면, 제 집에 오셔서 머물러 주십시오." 그가 계속 부탁해서 우리는 결국 그 집에 머물기로 했다.

pt.L: E, quando ela e a sua casa foram batizadas, ela [nos] suplicou, dizendo: "Se vocês me julgaram fiel ao Senhor, entrem na minha casa [e] fiquem." E ela nos obrigou [a aceitar].
pt.B: Depois que ela e os de sua casa foram batizados, ela insistiu conosco: "Se vocês estão convencidos de que eu sou fiel ao Senhor, venham ficar na minha casa." E insistiu tanto que acabamos aceitando.
pt.R: Lídia e as pessoas da casa dela foram batizadas. Depois ela nos pediu: "Se vocês concordam que eu confio de verdade no Senhor, venham ficar na minha casa." Ela insistiu até que nós aceitamos.

am.L: እርሷና ቤተ ሰዎቿም በተጠመቁ ጊዜ እንዲህ ብላ ለመነችን፦ «ለጌታ የታመንኩ መሆኔን ከፈረዳችሁ ወደ ቤቴ ገብታችሁ ተቀመጡ።» ግድም አለችን።
am.B: እርሷና ቤተሰቧ ከተጠመቁ በኋላ ግብዣዋን እንድንቀበል እንዲህ ብላ አጥብቃ ለመነችን፦ «በጌታ የታመንኩ መሆኔን ካመናችሁ ወደ ቤቴ ገብታችሁ ተቀመጡ።» እምቢ ልንላትም አልቻልንም።
am.R: ልድያና በቤቷ ያሉት ሰዎች ተጠመቁ። ከዚያም እንዲህ ብላ ለመነችን፦ «በእውነት በጌታ የማምን መሆኔን ከተቀበላችሁ ኑና በቤቴ ተቀመጡ።» እስክንስማማም ድረስ ለመነችን።

hi.L: और जब उसने और उसके घराने ने बपतिस्मा लिया, तो उसने विनती करके कहा, "यदि आप मुझे प्रभु की विश्वासी समझते हैं, तो मेरे घर में आकर रहिए।" और उसने हमें मना लिया।
hi.B: जब उसने और उसके घर के लोगों ने बपतिस्मा ले लिया, तो उसने हमसे आग्रह किया, "यदि आपको निश्चय है कि मैं प्रभु की सच्ची विश्वासी हूँ, तो मेरे घर आकर ठहरिए।" और उसने हमारी एक न सुनी, जब तक हम मान न गए।
hi.R: लुदिया और उसके घर के लोगों ने बपतिस्मा लिया। फिर उसने हमसे विनती की, "अगर आप मानते हैं कि मैं सचमुच प्रभु पर भरोसा रखती हूँ, तो आकर मेरे घर में ठहरिए।" वह तब तक कहती रही जब तक हम मान नहीं गए।

ru.L: Когда же крестилась она и её дом, она упросила, говоря: «Если вы признали меня верной Господу, войдя в мой дом, оставайтесь.» И она убедила нас.
ru.B: Когда она и её домашние крестились, она стала уговаривать нас: «Если вы признали, что я верна Господу, придите в мой дом и живите у меня.» И она настояла на своём.
ru.R: Лидия и люди в её доме крестились. Потом она стала просить нас: «Если вы согласны, что я правда верю в Господа, приходите и живите у меня в доме.» Она просила, пока мы не согласились.

uk.L: А коли вона та її дім охрестилися, вона просила, кажучи: «Якщо ви визнали мене вірною Господові, ввійдіть до мого дому [і] залишайтеся.» І вмовила нас.
uk.B: Після того як вона і її домашні охрестилися, вона почала наполегливо запрошувати нас: «Якщо ви вважаєте, що я вірна Господові, то зайдіть до мого дому й залишайтеся в мене.» І вона не прийняла відмови.
uk.R: Лідія і люди з її дому охрестилися. Потім вона почала благати нас: «Якщо ви згодні, що я справді вірю в Господа, то приходьте й живіть у моєму домі.» Вона просила доти, доки ми не погодилися.

ja.L: そして、彼女とその家の者たちが洗礼を受けたとき、彼女は[わたしたちに]願って言った。「もしあなたがたが、わたしを主に忠実な者と判断してくださるなら、わたしの家に来て泊まってください。」そして、わたしたちを無理に承知させた。
ja.B: 彼女とその家の者たちが洗礼を受けると、彼女はわたしたちに熱心に勧めて言った。「わたしが主を信じる者だと認めてくださるなら、どうぞわたしの家に来て、お泊まりください。」そして、どうしてもと言って聞かなかった。
ja.R: リディアと、その家の人たちは洗礼を受けました。それからリディアは、わたしたちに頼みました。「わたしが本当に主を信じていると思ってくださるなら、わたしの家に来て泊まってください。」彼女は、わたしたちが承知するまで頼み続けました。

decisions.choice: her household: those who lived under her roof, family and servants
decisions.reason: A household took in relatives, slaves and others who lived in the house. No husband is named, so she seems to have been its head. The text does not say whether there were children, or how old they were.

decisions.choice: faithful to the Lord: a true believer in the Lord
decisions.reason: The word can mean believing or trustworthy. Here it is the result of her baptism: she asks them to accept that she truly belongs to the Lord.

decisions.choice: prevailed upon: urged them until they gave in
decisions.reason: The same verb is used of the two disciples urging Jesus to stay at Emmaus (Luke 24:29).

decisions.choice: she would not take no for an answer
decisions.reason: Balanced puts the verb's sense of pressing until the other side yields into everyday words.

decisions.choice: truly trust in
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense chosen in the meaning note.

decisions.choice: sa maisonnée (L, B); les gens de sa maison (R)
decisions.reason: The household took in everyone under her roof, family and servants (m1). "Maisonnée" says that; "sa maison" would read as the building, and "sa famille" is narrower.

decisions.choice: Lydia says "các ông" to the missionaries and "tôi" for herself
decisions.reason: A woman of means speaking to visiting teachers: respectful but not humble.

decisions.choice: Lydia speaks to the missionaries in 합쇼체, "나" (L), "제" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A host inviting honoured guests speaks humbly in Korean; Literal keeps the plain pronoun of the Greek. "집안" for her household, those living under her roof (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: insistiu tanto que acabamos aceitando
alternatives: não aceitou um não como resposta
decisions.reason: Balanced says in ordinary Portuguese that she pressed until they gave in (m3); "constranger" in this old sense now reads as "embarrass" to Brazilians.

decisions.choice: "आप" from Lydia to Paul and his companions
decisions.reason: Lydia speaks to her guests and teachers, so Hindi gives her the respectful form, as people speaking to Jesus say "आप" (style guide section 4).

source.text: Ἐγένετο δὲ πορευομένων ἡμῶν εἰς τὴν προσευχὴν παιδίσκην τινὰ ἔχουσαν πνεῦμα πύθωνα ὑπαντῆσαι ἡμῖν, ἥτις ἐργασίαν πολλὴν παρεῖχεν τοῖς κυρίοις αὐτῆς μαντευομένη·

records.literal_gloss: It happened then, going of us to the place of prayer, a slave girl certain having a spirit, a python, met us, who profit much was bringing to the masters of her by fortune-telling.

en.L: And it happened, as we were going to the place of prayer, [that] a certain slave girl having a spirit of Python met us, who brought her masters much profit by fortune-telling.
en.B: Once, on our way to the place of prayer, a slave girl came to meet us who had a soothsaying spirit. Her fortune-telling brought in a large income for her masters.
en.R: One day we were going to the place of prayer. A slave girl met us who had a spirit in her that let her tell people what would happen in the future. Her owners made a lot of money from her fortune-telling.

es.L: Y sucedió que, yendo nosotros al lugar de oración, nos salió al encuentro una joven esclava que tenía un espíritu de Pitón, la cual daba mucha ganancia a sus amos adivinando.
es.B: Un día, cuando íbamos al lugar de oración, nos salió al encuentro una joven esclava que tenía un espíritu de adivinación. Con sus adivinaciones daba grandes ganancias a sus amos.
es.R: Un día íbamos al lugar de oración. Nos salió al encuentro una joven esclava que tenía dentro un espíritu que le permitía decirle a la gente lo que iba a pasar en el futuro. Sus dueños ganaban mucho dinero con lo que ella adivinaba.

fr.L: Et il arriva, comme nous allions au lieu de prière, qu’une jeune esclave qui avait un esprit de Python vint à notre rencontre ; elle procurait beaucoup de profit à ses maîtres en prédisant l’avenir.
fr.B: Un jour que nous allions au lieu de prière, une jeune esclave vint à notre rencontre. Elle avait un esprit de divination, et ses prédictions rapportaient beaucoup d’argent à ses maîtres.
fr.R: Un jour, nous allions au lieu de prière. Une jeune esclave est venue à notre rencontre. Elle avait en elle un esprit qui lui permettait de dire aux gens ce qui allait leur arriver. Ses propriétaires gagnaient beaucoup d’argent grâce à ses prédictions.

sw.L: Na ikawa, tulipokuwa tukienda mahali pa maombi, kijakazi mmoja mwenye pepo wa Pithoni alikutana nasi, ambaye aliwaletea mabwana zake faida nyingi kwa kubashiri.
sw.B: Siku moja, tulipokuwa tukienda mahali pa maombi, msichana mmoja mtumwa alikutana nasi. Alikuwa na pepo wa uaguzi, na kwa kubashiri aliwapatia mabwana zake mapato makubwa.
sw.R: Siku moja tulikuwa tukienda mahali pa maombi. Msichana mmoja mtumwa alikutana nasi. Alikuwa na pepo ndani yake aliyemwezesha kuwaambia watu mambo yatakayotokea baadaye. Wamiliki wake walipata pesa nyingi kutokana na ubashiri wake.

vi.L: Xảy ra khi chúng tôi đang đi đến chỗ cầu nguyện, có một đầy tớ gái bị linh bói toán ám, gặp chúng tôi; cô ta đem lại nhiều lợi lộc cho các chủ mình nhờ việc bói toán.
vi.B: Một lần, khi chúng tôi đang đi đến chỗ cầu nguyện, có một nữ nô lệ bị quỷ bói toán ám đến gặp chúng tôi. Cô ta bói toán và đem lại nhiều tiền lời cho các chủ mình.
vi.R: Một hôm chúng tôi đang đi đến chỗ cầu nguyện. Có một cô nô lệ gặp chúng tôi. Cô bị một tà linh ám, và tà linh ấy giúp cô nói cho người ta biết những gì sẽ xảy ra trong tương lai. Các chủ của cô kiếm được rất nhiều tiền nhờ việc bói toán của cô.

ko.L: 그리고 [이런] 일이 있었다. 우리가 기도하는 곳으로 가고 있을 때, 피톤의 영이 들린 어떤 여종이 우리와 마주쳤다. 그 여자는 점을 쳐서 자기 주인들에게 많은 돈벌이를 안겨 주고 있었다.
ko.B: 한번은 우리가 기도하는 곳으로 가다가, 점치는 영이 들린 여종 하나를 만났다. 그 여자는 점을 쳐서 주인들에게 많은 돈을 벌어 주고 있었다.
ko.R: 어느 날 우리가 기도하는 곳으로 가고 있을 때, 한 여종이 우리를 만났다. 그 여자 안에는 영이 들어 있어서, 그 영이 그 여자에게 앞으로 일어날 일을 사람들에게 알려 주게 했다. 그 여자의 주인들은 그 여자가 점을 쳐 주는 일로 많은 돈을 벌었다.

pt.L: E aconteceu que, indo nós ao lugar de oração, uma certa escrava que tinha um espírito de Píton veio ao nosso encontro; ela dava muito lucro aos seus senhores adivinhando.
pt.B: Certa vez, quando íamos ao lugar de oração, veio ao nosso encontro uma escrava que tinha um espírito de adivinhação. Com as suas adivinhações, ela dava muito lucro aos seus donos.
pt.R: Um dia nós estávamos indo para o lugar de oração. Uma escrava veio ao nosso encontro. Ela tinha dentro de si um espírito que a fazia dizer às pessoas o que ia acontecer no futuro. Os donos dela ganhavam muito dinheiro com as adivinhações dela.

am.L: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ወደ ጸሎት ስፍራ ስንሄድ የፒቶን መንፈስ ያለባት አንዲት ባሪያ ልጃገረድ አገኘችን፤ እርሷም በሟርቷ ለጌቶቿ ብዙ ትርፍ ታመጣ ነበር።
am.B: አንድ ቀን ወደ ጸሎት ስፍራ ስንሄድ የጥንቆላ መንፈስ ያለባት አንዲት ባሪያ ልጃገረድ አገኘችን። በሟርቷም ለጌቶቿ ብዙ ገቢ ታስገባ ነበር።
am.R: አንድ ቀን ወደ ጸሎት ስፍራ እየሄድን ነበር። ወደ ፊት የሚሆነውን ለሰዎች እንድትናገር የሚያደርግ መንፈስ ያለባት አንዲት ባሪያ ልጃገረድ አገኘችን። ጌቶቿም በሟርቷ ብዙ ገንዘብ ያገኙ ነበር።

hi.L: और ऐसा हुआ कि जब हम प्रार्थना के स्थान को जा रहे थे, तो एक दासी हमें मिली जिसमें पुथोन नाम की आत्मा थी, और वह भावी बताकर अपने स्वामियों के लिए बहुत कमाई करती थी।
hi.B: एक दिन जब हम प्रार्थना की जगह जा रहे थे, तो हमें एक दासी मिली जिसमें भविष्य बतानेवाली आत्मा थी। उसके भविष्य बताने से उसके स्वामियों को बहुत आमदनी होती थी।
hi.R: एक दिन हम प्रार्थना की जगह जा रहे थे। तब हमें एक दासी मिली, जिसमें एक आत्मा थी जिसके कारण वह लोगों को बता देती थी कि आगे क्या होगा। उसके मालिक उसके भविष्य बताने से बहुत पैसा कमाते थे।

ru.L: Случилось же, когда мы шли на место молитвы, [что] встретила нас одна рабыня, имеющая духа пифона, которая приносила большой доход своим господам, прорицая.
ru.B: Однажды, когда мы шли к месту молитвы, нам встретилась рабыня, в которой был дух прорицания. Своими предсказаниями она приносила своим хозяевам большой доход.
ru.R: Однажды мы шли к месту молитвы. Нам встретилась рабыня, в которой был дух, и он помогал ей предсказывать людям будущее. Её хозяева много зарабатывали на её гаданиях.

uk.L: Сталося ж, коли ми йшли до місця молитви, [що] зустріла нас одна рабиня, яка мала духа пітона, що приносила своїм панам великий прибуток віщуванням.
uk.B: Одного разу, коли ми йшли до місця молитви, нам назустріч вийшла рабиня, що мала віщунського духа. Її ворожіння приносило її панам великий прибуток.
uk.R: Одного дня ми йшли до місця молитви. Нам зустрілася рабиня, у якій був дух, що давав їй змогу передрікати людям майбутнє. Її власники заробляли на її ворожінні багато грошей.

ja.L: さて、わたしたちが祈りの場所に行く途中で、[次のことが]起こった。ピュトンの霊を持つ一人の奴隷の少女が、わたしたちに出会った。彼女は占いをして、その主人たちに多くの利益をもたらしていた。
ja.B: あるとき、わたしたちが祈りの場所に行く途中、占いの霊にとりつかれた奴隷の少女に出会った。この少女は占いによって、主人たちに多くの利益をもたらしていた。
ja.R: ある日、わたしたちは祈りの場所へ向かっていました。すると、一人の奴隷の少女に出会いました。この少女には、これから起こることを人々に告げさせる霊がついていました。少女の持ち主たちは、少女の占いでたくさんのお金をもうけていました。

decisions.choice: a spirit of Python: a spirit that gave oracles, as people believed the god of Delphi did
decisions.reason: Python was the serpent of Greek myth that guarded Delphi, the most famous oracle of the Greek world, before Apollo killed it. The name came to be used for a spirit that spoke through someone to foretell things, and for the people it spoke through; Plutarch uses it of those who spoke in a trance. People in Philippi would have taken the girl to be inspired by Apollo.

decisions.choice: a spirit: a real spirit, which Paul drives out
decisions.reason: Paul speaks to the spirit and it comes out (16:18), as unclean spirits do at Jesus's command (Luke 4:33-35). Luke does not call it unclean, but he treats it as opposed to God's work.

decisions.choice: fortune-telling: pagan divination
decisions.reason: This verb is used in the Greek Old Testament for the divination God forbids (Deuteronomy 18:10; 1 Samuel 28:8), never for the prophets of the Lord.

decisions.choice: a slave girl and her masters: she was owned, perhaps by partners
decisions.reason: Her owners, more than one, profited from her powers, as owners of a skilled slave would.

decisions.choice: a soothsaying spirit
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the name meant to its hearers; Literal keeps the name, which the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: a spirit in her that let her tell people what would happen in the future
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the spirit did.

decisions.choice: slave girl
decisions.reason: "Slave" at every level, as the style guide keeps it for people owned as property: her owners made money from her (m4).

decisions.choice: una joven esclava (every level)
decisions.reason: The term sheet gives "criada" for this word, but here she is owned and her masters live off her (meaning decision m4), and the English says "slave girl" at every level, so Spanish names her as a slave too.

decisions.choice: un espíritu de Pitón (L); un espíritu de adivinación (B); un espíritu que le permitía decir lo que iba a pasar (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the name, which points to the oracle of Delphi (meaning decision m1). Balanced and Readable say what the spirit did, as the English does.

decisions.choice: une jeune esclave at every level
decisions.reason: As the English and the term sheet: "esclave" where slavery itself is the point; her owners made money from her (m4). "Servante" would hide that she was owned.

decisions.choice: kijakazi (L); msichana mtumwa (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term sheet gives "mtumishi wa kike" at Balanced and Readable, but here slavery itself is the point: she is owned and her masters live off her (meaning decision m4). So Balanced and Readable say "mtumwa", as the term sheet allows where slavery is meant.

decisions.choice: pepo wa Pithoni (L); pepo wa uaguzi (B); pepo aliyemwezesha kuwaambia watu mambo yatakayotokea (R)
decisions.reason: "Pepo", the term-sheet word for an evil spirit, since Paul drives it out (meaning decision m2); "roho" is kept for the Holy Spirit and the human spirit. Literal keeps the name, which points to the oracle of Delphi (meaning decision m1); Balanced and Readable say what the spirit did.

decisions.choice: "đầy tớ gái" (L); "nữ nô lệ", "cô nô lệ" (B, R); "linh bói toán" (L), "quỷ bói toán" (B), "tà linh" (R) for the spirit of Python
decisions.reason: The meaning decision says she was owned, so Balanced and Readable say "nô lệ" plainly. The Greek names the spirit after the Python of Delphi; Vietnamese readers do not know that name, so the levels say what the spirit did.

decisions.choice: "피톤의 영" (L); "점치는 영" (B); "앞으로 일어날 일을 ... 알려 주게 했다" (R); "여종" at every level
decisions.reason: The Greek names the spirit after Python, the serpent of the oracle at Delphi (meaning decision); Literal keeps the name, Balanced says what it did. She was owned (meaning decision), so "여종" stays at every level, as "종" does for doulos in the Korean Gospels.

decisions.choice: um espírito de adivinhação
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the name meant to its hearers, as the English "soothsaying spirit" does; Portuguese "pitonisa" exists but is rare, and "pitônico" is not current.

decisions.choice: "የፒቶን መንፈስ" (L); "የጥንቆላ መንፈስ" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek name Python, the oracle snake of Delphi; Balanced says what kind of spirit it was, a spirit of soothsaying. "ጋኔን" would settle in the wording what the meaning decision leaves to the narrative.

decisions.choice: "ባሪያ ልጃገረድ" (slave girl) at every level
decisions.reason: She was owned by her masters, who profited from her (meaning decision), so "ባሪያ" is kept at every level as the style guide sets for slaves.

decisions.choice: "पुथोन नाम की आत्मा" (L); "भविष्य बतानेवाली आत्मा" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Python was the name of the serpent linked with the oracle of Delphi (meaning decision m1). Literal keeps the name; Balanced and Readable say what the spirit did, as the English does.

She was owned as property and earned money for her owners (meaning decision m4), so she is a slave at every level, as the style guide keeps doulos (section 6). The owners are named as Luke's masters are (section 7b).

decisions.choice: "дух пифона"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek name of the oracle-giving spirit, after the serpent of Delphi; Balanced says what it did.

decisions.choice: "рабыня"
decisions.reason: She was owned, so "рабыня" at every level, as for "раб".

decisions.choice: "рабиня" for *paidiskē* here
decisions.reason: She is owned by masters who profit from her, which "служниця" (used for Rhoda in 12:13) would hide; the English has "slave girl" at every level.

decisions.choice: "дух пітона" (L), "віщунський дух" (B)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Greek name for an oracle spirit, after the serpent of Delphi; Balanced says what it was.

decisions.choice: "ピュトンの霊" (L); "占いの霊" (B); a description of what the spirit did (R)
decisions.reason: As the English: Literal keeps the name, which meaning decision m1 explains; Balanced says what the name meant to its hearers; Readable says plainly what the spirit did.

decisions.choice: "奴隷の少女" at every level
decisions.reason: Her owners made money from her (meaning decision m4), so slavery itself is the point and "奴隷" stays at every level, as in the English.

source.text: αὕτη κατακολουθοῦσα τῷ Παύλῳ καὶ ἡμῖν ἔκραζεν λέγουσα· Οὗτοι οἱ ἄνθρωποι δοῦλοι τοῦ θεοῦ τοῦ ὑψίστου εἰσίν, οἵτινες καταγγέλλουσιν ὑμῖν ὁδὸν σωτηρίας.

records.literal_gloss: She following the Paul and us was crying out saying, These the men slaves of the God the Most High are, who proclaim to you a way of salvation.

en.L: She, following Paul and us, kept crying out, saying, "These men are slaves of the Most High God, who proclaim to you a way of salvation."
en.B: She trailed after Paul and the rest of us, crying out, "These men are servants of the Most High God, and they are announcing to you a way of salvation!"
en.R: She followed Paul and the rest of us around and kept shouting, "These men are servants of the Most High God! They are telling you how you can be saved!"

es.L: Esta, siguiendo a Pablo y a nosotros, gritaba diciendo: «Estos hombres son esclavos del Dios Altísimo, los cuales {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncian un camino de salvación».
es.B: Ella iba detrás de Pablo y de los demás, y gritaba: «¡Estos hombres son siervos del Dios Altísimo, y {{plural_you:les|os}} anuncian un camino de salvación!».
es.R: Seguía a Pablo y a los demás por todas partes, y gritaba una y otra vez: «¡Estos hombres son siervos del Dios Altísimo! ¡Ellos {{plural_you:les|os}} dicen cómo {{plural_you:pueden|podéis}} ser salvos!».

fr.L: Celle-ci, suivant Paul et nous, criait, disant : « Ces hommes sont esclaves du Dieu Très-Haut, eux qui vous annoncent un chemin de salut. »
fr.B: Elle se mit à suivre Paul et le reste d’entre nous en criant : « Ces hommes sont des serviteurs du Dieu Très-Haut, et ils vous annoncent un chemin de salut ! »
fr.R: Elle suivait Paul et le reste d’entre nous partout, et elle criait sans arrêt : « Ces hommes sont des serviteurs du Dieu Très-Haut ! Ils vous disent comment vous pouvez être sauvés ! »

sw.L: Huyo, akimfuata Paulo na sisi, alikuwa akipiga kelele akisema, "Watu hawa ni watumwa wa Mungu Aliye Juu Kabisa, ambao wanawatangazia njia ya wokovu."
sw.B: Alikuwa akimfuata Paulo na sisi wengine, akipaza sauti, "Watu hawa ni watumishi wa Mungu Aliye Juu Kabisa, nao wanawatangazia njia ya wokovu!"
sw.R: Alimfuata Paulo na sisi wengine kila mahali, akipiga kelele tena na tena, "Watu hawa ni watumishi wa Mungu Aliye Juu Kabisa! Wanawaambia jinsi mnavyoweza kuokolewa!"

vi.L: Cô ta theo sau Phao-lô và chúng tôi mà kêu lên rằng: "Những người này là nô lệ của Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao, là những người rao truyền cho các người một con đường cứu rỗi."
vi.B: Cô ta đi theo sau Phao-lô và chúng tôi, kêu lớn: "Những người này là đầy tớ của Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao. Họ đang rao truyền cho các người một con đường cứu rỗi!"
vi.R: Cô ta cứ đi theo Phao-lô và chúng tôi và kêu lớn: "Những người này là đầy tớ của Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao! Họ đang cho các người biết làm thế nào để được cứu!"

ko.L: 이 여자가 바울과 우리를 따라다니면서 소리를 질러 말했다. "이 사람들은 가장 높으신 하나님의 종들이다. 너희에게 구원의 길을 선포하고 있다."
ko.B: 그 여자는 바울과 우리를 따라다니면서 외쳤다. "이 사람들은 가장 높으신 하나님의 종들이다! 너희에게 구원의 길을 전하고 있다!"
ko.R: 그 여자는 바울과 우리를 계속 따라다니면서 소리쳤다. "이 사람들은 가장 높으신 하나님의 종들이다! 너희가 어떻게 구원받을 수 있는지 알려 주고 있다!"

pt.L: Ela, seguindo Paulo e a nós, gritava, dizendo: "Estes homens são escravos do Deus Altíssimo, que anunciam a vocês um caminho de salvação."
pt.B: Ela ia atrás de Paulo e de nós, gritando: "Estes homens são servos do Deus Altíssimo e estão anunciando a vocês um caminho de salvação!"
pt.R: Ela seguia Paulo e o resto de nós por toda parte e gritava sem parar: "Estes homens são servos do Deus Altíssimo! Eles estão dizendo a vocês como podem ser salvos!"

am.L: እርሷም ጳውሎስንና እኛን እየተከተለች እንዲህ ብላ ትጮኽ ነበር፦ «እነዚህ ሰዎች የልዑል እግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ናቸው፤ እነርሱም የመዳን መንገድ ያውጁላችኋል።»
am.B: እርሷም ጳውሎስንና የቀረነውን እኛን እየተከተለች እንዲህ እያለች ትጮኽ ነበር፦ «እነዚህ ሰዎች የልዑል እግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ናቸው፤ የመዳን መንገድ ያውጁላችኋል!»
am.R: እርሷም ጳውሎስንና እኛን በየሄድንበት ትከተለን ነበር። እንዲህም እያለች ትጮኽ ነበር፦ «እነዚህ ሰዎች የልዑል እግዚአብሔር ባሪያዎች ናቸው! እንዴት መዳን እንደምትችሉ ይነግሯችኋል!»

hi.L: वह पौलुस के और हमारे पीछे-पीछे आकर चिल्लाती थी, "ये मनुष्य परमप्रधान परमेश्वर के दास हैं, जो तुम्हें उद्धार का एक मार्ग बताते हैं।"
hi.B: वह पौलुस और हम सब के पीछे-पीछे चलती हुई चिल्लाती रहती, "ये लोग परमप्रधान परमेश्वर के दास हैं, और तुम्हें उद्धार का एक मार्ग बता रहे हैं!"
hi.R: वह पौलुस और हम सब के पीछे-पीछे घूमती और चिल्लाती रहती, "ये लोग परमप्रधान परमेश्वर के दास हैं! ये तुम्हें बता रहे हैं कि तुम्हारा उद्धार कैसे हो सकता है!"

ru.L: Она, следуя за Павлом и нами, кричала, говоря: «Эти люди — рабы Бога Всевышнего, которые возвещают вам путь спасения.»
ru.B: Она ходила за Павлом и за нами и кричала: «Эти люди — рабы Всевышнего Бога, они возвещают вам путь спасения!»
ru.R: Она ходила за Павлом и за всеми нами и кричала: «Эти люди — рабы Всевышнего Бога! Они рассказывают вам, как можно спастись!»

uk.L: Вона, ідучи за Павлом і нами, кричала, кажучи: «Ці люди — раби Бога Всевишнього, які звіщають вам дорогу спасіння.»
uk.B: Вона йшла слідом за Павлом і нами й вигукувала: «Ці люди — раби Всевишнього Бога, і вони звіщають вам дорогу спасіння!»
uk.R: Вона ходила за Павлом і за нами всіма й кричала: «Ці люди — слуги Всевишнього Бога! Вони розповідають вам, як ви можете спастися!»

ja.L: 彼女はパウロとわたしたちの後について来て、叫び続けて言った。「この人たちは、いと高き神の奴隷たちで、あなたがたに救いの道を告げ伝えている。」
ja.B: 彼女はパウロやわたしたちの後について来て、「この人たちは、いと高き神のしもべたちで、あなたがたに救いの道を告げ伝えているのだ！」と叫んだ。
ja.R: 少女はパウロとわたしたちの後をついて回り、叫び続けました。「この人たちは、最も高い神のしもべたちだ！あなたたちが救われる道を伝えている！」

decisions.choice: the Most High God: true in itself, but a title pagans also used for their highest god
decisions.reason: The title goes back to Genesis 14:18-20. Demons cried out to Jesus as "Son of the Most High God" (Luke 8:28). In the Greek world, inscriptions honor Zeus and other gods as "the Most High", so hearers in Philippi might not have known which god was meant.

decisions.choice: a way of salvation: one way among others, as her hearers would take it
decisions.reason: There is no article. Her words are true as far as they go, but in a city of many gods they could sound like one more path. This may be why Paul was troubled (16:18).

decisions.choice: slaves: men wholly owned by God
decisions.reason: The word means a slave. The apostles use it of themselves (Romans 1:1; Philippians 1:1) and of believers in prayer (4:29).

decisions.choice: these men: Paul and his companions
decisions.reason: The word here points to particular men, the missionaries.

decisions.choice: SBLGNT: "to you"
decisions.reason: The two Greek pronouns sounded alike and were often confused by copyists. "To you" is better attested. Reviewers should check this against the apparatus.

decisions.choice: how you can be saved
decisions.reason: Readable puts the noun as a verb. It keeps the sense of the meaning note, since "how" does not claim it is the only way.

decisions.choice: servants
decisions.reason: "Servant" in Balanced and Readable, as the style guide has it; the meaning decision (m3) keeps that the person was owned, and Literal keeps "slave".

decisions.choice: esclavos (L); siervos (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet rendering, recorded once in this chapter, as the English: Literal shows that they are wholly owned by God (meaning decision m3); Balanced and Readable say "siervos", since slavery itself is not the point here.

decisions.choice: esclaves (L); serviteurs (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet settles for slaves of God: Literal keeps "esclaves", Balanced and Readable say "serviteurs", as the English does; the meaning decision (m3) keeps that they belonged wholly to God.

decisions.choice: watumwa (L); watumishi (B, R)
decisions.reason: The term-sheet rendering, recorded once in this chapter, as the English: Literal shows that they are wholly owned by God (meaning decision m3); Balanced and Readable say "watumishi", since slavery itself is not the point here.

decisions.choice: "Đức Chúa Trời Chí Cao" for the Most High God
decisions.reason: "Chí Cao" as in Luke 1:76 ("Đấng Chí Cao").

decisions.choice: the girl shouts to the passers-by in 해라체
decisions.reason: She cries out to the street, not to anyone in particular; the plain style suits a shout. "종들" at every level for the slaves of God, as in the Korean letters.

decisions.choice: "ባሪያዎች" (slaves) at every level, where the English Balanced and Readable say "servants"
decisions.reason: The Amharic style guide keeps "ባሪያ" for doulos at every level; "የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ" is a familiar and honourable phrase in Amharic, and it keeps the sense of men wholly owned by God (meaning decision).

decisions.choice: "दास" at every level; "परमप्रधान परमेश्वर"
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps doulos as "दास" at every level (section 6), and here the men are wholly owned by God (meaning decision m3). "परमप्रधान" is Luke's word for the Most High (section 7b).

decisions.choice: "उद्धार का एक मार्ग" (L, B); "कैसे हो सकता है" (R)
decisions.reason: The Greek has no article: to her hearers it would be one way among others (meaning decision m2), so Hindi says "एक". "मार्ग" is also the word Acts uses for the Way.

decisions.choice: "рабы"
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "раб" for doulos at every level; the English Balanced and Readable say "servants".

decisions.choice: "раби" (L, B), "слуги" (R) for *douloi*
decisions.reason: The brief keeps "раб" for *doulos*; Readable says "слуги", where the point is that they serve the Most High God.

decisions.choice: "奴隷たち" (L), "しもべたち" (B, R); "いと高き神" (L, B), "最も高い神" (R)
decisions.reason: "Slave" follows the usual pattern for the word (Literal 奴隷, Balanced and Readable しもべ). "いと高き神" is the set Japanese title for the Most High; Readable uses everyday words. The Japanese, like the Greek, does not say that hers was the only way (meaning decision m2).

source.text: τοῦτο δὲ ἐποίει ἐπὶ πολλὰς ἡμέρας.

records.literal_gloss: This then she was doing for many days.

en.L: And she was doing this for many days.
en.B: She kept this up for many days.
en.R: She did this day after day for a long time.

es.L: Y esto hacía durante muchos días.
es.B: Así lo estuvo haciendo durante muchos días.
es.R: Hizo esto día tras día durante mucho tiempo.

fr.L: Et elle faisait cela pendant bien des jours.
fr.B: Elle continua ainsi pendant de nombreux jours.
fr.R: Elle a fait cela jour après jour, pendant longtemps.

sw.L: Na alikuwa akifanya hivyo siku nyingi.
sw.B: Aliendelea kufanya hivyo kwa siku nyingi.
sw.R: Alifanya hivyo siku baada ya siku kwa muda mrefu.

vi.L: Cô ta làm như vậy nhiều ngày.
vi.B: Cô ta cứ làm như thế nhiều ngày.
vi.R: Ngày nào cô cũng làm như vậy, suốt một thời gian dài.

ko.L: 그리고 그 여자는 여러 날 동안 이렇게 하고 있었다.
ko.B: 그 여자는 여러 날 동안 계속 그렇게 했다.
ko.R: 그 여자는 오랫동안 날마다 그렇게 했다.

pt.L: E ela fazia isso por muitos dias.
pt.B: Ela continuou fazendo isso por muitos dias.
pt.R: Ela fez isso dia após dia, durante muito tempo.

am.L: ይህንም ብዙ ቀን ታደርግ ነበር።
am.B: ይህን ለብዙ ቀናት ቀጠለችበት።
am.R: ይህን ለረጅም ጊዜ በየቀኑ ታደርግ ነበር።

hi.L: और वह बहुत दिनों तक ऐसा करती रही।
hi.B: वह बहुत दिनों तक ऐसा करती रही।
hi.R: वह बहुत दिनों तक रोज़ यही करती रही।

ru.L: Это же она делала много дней.
ru.B: Так она делала много дней.
ru.R: Она делала это день за днём долгое время.

uk.L: І це вона робила багато днів.
uk.B: Так вона робила багато днів.
uk.R: Вона робила так день у день досить довго.

ja.L: そして彼女は、これを何日もの間続けていた。
ja.B: 彼女は何日もこれを続けた。
ja.R: 少女は、来る日も来る日も、長い間これを続けました。

decisions.choice: was doing: again and again
decisions.reason: The imperfect shows that it went on day after day.

source.text: διαπονηθεὶς δὲ Παῦλος καὶ ἐπιστρέψας τῷ πνεύματι εἶπεν· Παραγγέλλω σοι ἐν ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐξελθεῖν ἀπ’ αὐτῆς· καὶ ἐξῆλθεν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ.

records.literal_gloss: Having been greatly troubled then Paul and having turned to the spirit said, I command you in name of Jesus Christ to come out from her; and it came out in the same hour.

en.L: But Paul, greatly troubled, turned and said to the spirit, "I command you in [the] name of Jesus {{christos:Christ|Messiah}} to come out of her." And it came out that very hour.
en.B: In the end Paul grew weary and vexed. He turned and told the spirit, "I order you in the name of Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}} to come out of her!" It came out that same hour.
en.R: Paul became very upset. He turned around and said to the spirit, "By the power of Jesus {{christos:Christ|the Messiah}}, I order you to come out of her!" At once the spirit left her.

es.L: Pero Pablo, muy molesto, se volvió y dijo al espíritu: «Te ordeno en [el] nombre de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}} que salgas de ella». Y salió en aquella misma hora.
es.B: Al final Pablo, cansado y molesto, se volvió y le dijo al espíritu: «¡En el nombre de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, te ordeno que salgas de ella!». Y en ese mismo momento salió.
es.R: Pablo se molestó mucho. Se dio vuelta y le dijo al espíritu: «¡Por el poder de {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}, te ordeno que salgas de ella!». Al instante el espíritu salió de ella.

fr.L: Mais Paul, très contrarié, se retourna et dit à l’esprit : « Je t’ordonne, au nom de Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}}, de sortir d’elle. » Et il sortit à l’heure même.
fr.B: À la fin, Paul, à bout de patience, se retourna et dit à l’esprit : « Je t’ordonne au nom de Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} de sortir d’elle ! » Et l’esprit sortit à l’instant même.
fr.R: Paul en a eu assez. Il s’est retourné et a dit à l’esprit : « Par la puissance de Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}}, je t’ordonne de sortir de cette fille ! » Aussitôt, l’esprit l’a quittée.

sw.L: Lakini Paulo, akiwa amechukizwa sana, aligeuka akamwambia yule pepo, "Nakuamuru kwa jina la Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}} umtoke." Naye akamtoka saa ile ile.
sw.B: Mwishowe Paulo alichoshwa na kuudhika, akageuka, akamwambia yule pepo, "Nakuamuru kwa jina la Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}: mtoke msichana huyu!" Pepo huyo akamtoka saa ile ile.
sw.R: Paulo aliudhika sana. Akageuka, akamwambia yule pepo, "Kwa uwezo wa Yesu {{christos:Kristo|Masihi}}, nakuamuru umtoke msichana huyu!" Mara moja yule pepo akamtoka.

vi.L: Phao-lô bực mình, quay lại nói với linh ấy: "Nhân danh Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, ta truyền lệnh cho ngươi phải ra khỏi cô này." Và ngay giờ đó nó ra khỏi.
vi.B: Cuối cùng Phao-lô bực mình, quay lại bảo linh ấy: "Nhân danh Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, ta ra lệnh cho ngươi phải ra khỏi cô này!" Ngay giờ đó tà linh ra khỏi cô.
vi.R: Phao-lô rất bực. Ông quay lại nói với tà linh: "Bởi quyền năng của Đức Giê-xu {{christos:Christ|Mê-si-a}}, ta ra lệnh cho ngươi phải ra khỏi cô này!" Lập tức tà linh ra khỏi cô.

ko.L: 그러자 바울이 몹시 괴로워하여 돌아서서 그 영에게 말했다. "내가 예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 이름으로 너에게 명령한다. 그 여자에게서 나오라." 그러자 바로 그 시간에 [영이] 나왔다.
ko.B: 마침내 바울은 몹시 괴로워하며 돌아서서 그 영에게 말했다. "예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 이름으로 너에게 명령한다. 그 여자에게서 나오너라!" 그러자 바로 그 순간 영이 나왔다.
ko.R: 바울은 몹시 괴로웠다. 그는 돌아서서 그 영에게 말했다. "예수 {{christos:그리스도|메시아}}의 능력으로 너에게 명령한다. 그 여자에게서 나오너라!" 그러자 곧바로 영이 그 여자에게서 나갔다.

pt.L: Mas Paulo, muito aborrecido, voltou-se e disse ao espírito: "Eu lhe ordeno em nome de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|Messias}} que saia dela." E ele saiu naquela mesma hora.
pt.B: Por fim, Paulo, cansado e irritado, voltou-se e disse ao espírito: "Eu lhe ordeno em nome de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}} que saia dela!" E o espírito saiu naquele mesmo instante.
pt.R: Paulo ficou muito irritado. Ele se virou e disse ao espírito: "Pelo poder de Jesus {{christos:Cristo|o Messias}}, eu ordeno que você saia dela!" Na mesma hora, o espírito saiu dela.

am.L: ጳውሎስም እጅግ ተቸግሮ ዘወር አለና መንፈሱን እንዲህ አለው፦ «ከእርሷ እንድትወጣ በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ስም አዝሃለሁ።» በዚያችም ሰዓት ወጣ።
am.B: በመጨረሻ ጳውሎስ ተሰላችቶና ተበሳጭቶ ዘወር አለና መንፈሱን እንዲህ አለው፦ «በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ስም ከእርሷ እንድትወጣ አዝሃለሁ!» በዚያችም ሰዓት ወጣ።
am.R: ጳውሎስ በጣም ተበሳጨ። ዘወር ብሎም መንፈሱን እንዲህ አለው፦ «በኢየሱስ {{christos:ክርስቶስ|መሲሕ}} ሥልጣን ከእርሷ እንድትወጣ አዝሃለሁ!» መንፈሱም ወዲያውኑ ለቀቃት።

hi.L: पर पौलुस बहुत खिन्न हुआ और मुड़कर उस आत्मा से कहा, "मैं तुझे यीशु मसीह के नाम से आज्ञा देता हूँ कि उसमें से निकल जा।" और वह उसी घड़ी निकल गई।
hi.B: आख़िर पौलुस तंग आ गया और खीजकर मुड़ा और उस आत्मा से बोला, "मैं तुझे यीशु मसीह के नाम से आज्ञा देता हूँ कि उसमें से निकल जा!" और वह उसी घड़ी निकल गई।
hi.R: पौलुस बहुत परेशान हो गया। उसने मुड़कर उस आत्मा से कहा, "मैं यीशु मसीह की शक्ति से तुझे आज्ञा देता हूँ कि उसमें से निकल जा!" उसी समय वह आत्मा उसमें से निकल गई।

ru.L: Павел же, вознегодовав и обернувшись, сказал духу: «Повелеваю тебе во имя Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} выйти из неё.» И он вышел в тот же час.
ru.B: Наконец Павел, утомлённый и раздосадованный, обернулся и сказал духу: «Во имя Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} приказываю тебе выйти из неё!» И дух вышел в тот же час.
ru.R: Павел очень расстроился. Он обернулся и сказал духу: «Силой Иисуса {{christos:Христа|Мессии}} приказываю тебе выйти из неё!» И дух сразу вышел из неё.

uk.L: Павло ж, дуже обурившись і обернувшись, сказав духові: «Наказую тобі в імʼя Ісуса {{christos:Христа|Месії}} вийти з неї.» І він вийшов тієї ж години.
uk.B: Зрештою Павло втомився й розгнівався. Він обернувся й сказав духові: «Наказую тобі в імʼя Ісуса {{christos:Христа|Месії}}: вийди з неї!» І дух вийшов тієї ж години.
uk.R: Павло дуже розсердився. Він обернувся й сказав духові: «Силою Ісуса {{christos:Христа|Месії}} наказую тобі вийти з неї!» І дух відразу покинув її.

ja.L: しかし、パウロはひどく困り果て、振り向いてその霊に言った。「イエス・{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の名によって、おまえに命じる。この女から出て行け。」すると、ちょうどその時に[霊は]出て行った。
ja.B: とうとうパウロはうんざりし、いら立って、振り向いてその霊に言った。「イエス・{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の名によって命じる。この女から出て行け！」すると、霊はたちどころに出て行った。
ja.R: パウロは、とても腹を立てました。そして振り向いて、その霊に言いました。「イエス・{{christos:キリスト|メシア}}の力によって命じる。この少女から出て行け！」すると、すぐに霊は少女から出て行きました。

decisions.choice: greatly troubled: annoyed and worn down
decisions.reason: The verb means to be deeply disturbed or exasperated; the leaders were so with the apostles in 4:2. Luke does not say why: perhaps the noise, perhaps that a pagan spirit was announcing the message and confusing it.

decisions.choice: in the name of Jesus Christ: by his authority and power
decisions.reason: As in 3:6 and 3:16, the name stands for the person. In 19:13-16 those who use the name like a spell are overpowered.

decisions.choice: that very hour: at once
decisions.reason: An hour often means simply the moment (Luke 2:38, 7:21).

decisions.choice: by the power of
decisions.reason: Readable says what the name means here, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: in the end
decisions.reason: Balanced shows that his patience ran out after many days (16:18).

decisions.choice: {{christos:Jesucristo|Jesús, el Mesías}}
decisions.reason: The English span covers only "Christ". Spanish writes the name as one word, "Jesucristo", so the span takes in the whole name, as the term sheet sets for every "Jesus Christ".

decisions.choice: Jésus {{christos:Christ|Messie}} (L); Jésus {{christos:Christ|le Messie}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the style guide settles: without the hyphen of "Jésus-Christ", so that both options read naturally; Literal follows the Greek with no article, as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: Paul says "ta" and "ngươi" to the spirit
decisions.reason: A command with authority to an evil spirit, not speech between people; "ta ... ngươi" is the form of a master to a subordinate, as Jesus' commands to spirits read in the Vietnamese Gospels.

decisions.choice: "मसीह" with no christos span
decisions.reason: The style guide keeps "मसीह" at every level with no setting (section 7): it is both the familiar name in "यीशु मसीह" and the word Messiah itself.

decisions.choice: "तुझे ... निकल जा" (तू) to the spirit
decisions.reason: Paul commands an evil spirit; Hindi uses the blunt तू of command, as for a spirit cast out in the Gospels. The spirit itself takes feminine agreement here ("निकल गई"), as "आत्मा" does when it is not the Holy Spirit.

decisions.choice: Paul's command to the spirit in the plain imperative "出て行け", with "おまえ" (L)
decisions.reason: A command that drives out a spirit is spoken with authority, not politely; "〜なさい" would sound like advice to a child.

source.text: Ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ κύριοι αὐτῆς ὅτι ἐξῆλθεν ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς ἐργασίας αὐτῶν ἐπιλαβόμενοι τὸν Παῦλον καὶ τὸν Σιλᾶν εἵλκυσαν εἰς τὴν ἀγορὰν ἐπὶ τοὺς ἄρχοντας, καὶ προσαγαγόντες αὐτοὺς τοῖς στρατηγοῖς εἶπαν· Οὗτοι οἱ ἄνθρωποι ἐκταράσσουσιν ἡμῶν τὴν πόλιν Ἰουδαῖοι ὑπάρχοντες, καὶ καταγγέλλουσιν ἔθη ἃ οὐκ ἔξεστιν ἡμῖν παραδέχεσθαι οὐδὲ ποιεῖν Ῥωμαίοις οὖσιν.

records.literal_gloss: Having seen then the masters of her that went out the hope of the profit of them, having seized the Paul and the Silas they dragged [them] into the marketplace before the rulers, \v 20 and having brought them to the magistrates they said, These the men are throwing into confusion our the city, Jews being, \v 21 and they proclaim customs which not it is lawful for us to accept nor to practice, Romans being.

en.L: But when her masters saw that the hope of their profit had gone out, they seized Paul and Silas and dragged [them] into the marketplace before the rulers, \v 20 and bringing them to the magistrates, they said, "These men are throwing our city into confusion, being Jews, \v 21 and they proclaim customs that it is not lawful for us to accept or to practice, being Romans."
en.B: Her masters saw that their hope of gain had gone out of her along with the spirit. So they laid hold of Paul and Silas and hauled them off to the rulers in the marketplace. \v 20 Bringing them before the magistrates, they said, "These men are upsetting our whole city. They are Jews, \v 21 and they preach customs that we cannot lawfully take up or follow, since we are Romans."
en.R: The girl's owners saw that she could no longer make money for them. So they grabbed Paul and Silas and dragged them to the city leaders in the marketplace. \v 20 They brought them to the chief officials of the city and said, "These men are Jews, and they are causing a lot of trouble in our city. \v 21 They are teaching customs that we Romans are not allowed to accept or follow."

es.L: Pero al ver sus amos que había salido la esperanza de su ganancia, prendieron a Pablo y a Silas y [los] arrastraron a la plaza ante las autoridades, \v 20 y presentándolos a los magistrados, dijeron: «Estos hombres están alborotando nuestra ciudad, siendo judíos, \v 21 y anuncian costumbres que no nos es lícito aceptar ni practicar, siendo romanos».
es.B: Cuando sus amos vieron que, con el espíritu, había salido de ella también su esperanza de ganancia, agarraron a Pablo y a Silas y los arrastraron ante las autoridades en la plaza pública. \v 20 Los presentaron ante los magistrados y dijeron: «Estos hombres están alborotando toda nuestra ciudad. Son judíos, \v 21 y enseñan costumbres que a nosotros, como romanos, no nos está permitido adoptar ni practicar».
es.R: Los dueños de la muchacha vieron que ella ya no podía ganar dinero para ellos. Entonces agarraron a Pablo y a Silas y los llevaron a rastras ante los jefes de la ciudad, en la plaza. \v 20 Los llevaron ante los principales funcionarios de la ciudad y dijeron: «Estos hombres son judíos, y están causando muchos problemas en nuestra ciudad. \v 21 Enseñan costumbres que nosotros, los romanos, no podemos aceptar ni seguir».

fr.L: Mais ses maîtres, voyant que l’espoir de leur profit était sorti, saisirent Paul et Silas et [les] traînèrent sur la place publique devant les autorités, \v 20 et les ayant amenés aux magistrats, ils dirent : « Ces hommes jettent le trouble dans notre ville, étant Juifs, \v 21 et ils annoncent des coutumes qu’il ne nous est pas permis d’accepter ni de pratiquer, étant Romains. »
fr.B: Ses maîtres virent qu’avec l’esprit, l’espoir de leur gain était sorti d’elle. Ils s’emparèrent donc de Paul et de Silas et les traînèrent sur la place publique, devant les autorités. \v 20 Ils les présentèrent aux magistrats et dirent : « Ces hommes mettent toute notre ville en émoi. Ce sont des Juifs, \v 21 et ils prêchent des coutumes qu’il ne nous est pas permis d’adopter ni de suivre, à nous qui sommes Romains. »
fr.R: Les propriétaires de la jeune fille ont vu qu’elle ne pouvait plus leur faire gagner d’argent. Alors ils ont attrapé Paul et Silas et les ont traînés sur la grande place, devant les chefs de la ville. \v 20 Ils les ont amenés aux principaux responsables de la ville et ont dit : « Ces hommes sont des Juifs, et ils causent beaucoup de désordre dans notre ville. \v 21 Ils enseignent des coutumes que nous, les Romains, nous n’avons pas le droit d’accepter ni de suivre. »

sw.L: Lakini mabwana zake walipoona kwamba tumaini la faida yao limetoka, waliwakamata Paulo na Sila, wakawaburuta mpaka sokoni mbele ya watawala, \v 20 na wakiisha kuwaleta kwa mahakimu, walisema, "Watu hawa wanauvuruga mji wetu, wakiwa Wayahudi, \v 21 nao wanatangaza desturi ambazo si halali kwetu kuzipokea wala kuzifanya, tukiwa Warumi."
sw.B: Mabwana zake walipoona kwamba tumaini lao la kupata faida limetoka pamoja na yule pepo, waliwakamata Paulo na Sila, wakawaburuta mpaka kwa watawala kwenye uwanja wa soko. \v 20 Wakawaleta mbele ya mahakimu, wakasema, "Watu hawa wanauvuruga mji wetu wote. Wao ni Wayahudi, \v 21 nao wanafundisha desturi ambazo sisi, kwa kuwa ni Warumi, haturuhusiwi kisheria kuzikubali wala kuzifuata."
sw.R: Wamiliki wa yule msichana waliona kwamba hangeweza tena kuwapatia pesa. Basi wakawakamata Paulo na Sila, wakawaburuta mpaka kwa viongozi wa mji sokoni. \v 20 Wakawaleta mbele ya maafisa wakuu wa mji, wakasema, "Watu hawa ni Wayahudi, nao wanaleta fujo kubwa katika mji wetu. \v 21 Wanafundisha desturi ambazo sisi Warumi hatuna ruhusa kuzikubali wala kuzifuata."

vi.L: Các chủ của cô thấy hy vọng kiếm lời của mình đã mất, liền bắt Phao-lô và Si-la, kéo đến chợ trước mặt các nhà cầm quyền, \v 20 và giải họ đến trước các quan tòa, nói: "Những người này làm rối loạn thành chúng ta, họ là người Do Thái, \v 21 và họ truyền bá những tục lệ mà chúng ta là người La Mã không được phép chấp nhận hay làm theo."
vi.B: Các chủ của cô thấy hy vọng kiếm tiền của họ cũng đã ra đi cùng với tà linh, nên bắt Phao-lô và Si-la, kéo đến quảng trường trước mặt các nhà cầm quyền. \v 20 Họ giải hai người đến trước các quan tòa và nói: "Những người này đang làm náo loạn cả thành chúng ta. Họ là người Do Thái, \v 21 và họ truyền bá những tục lệ mà chúng ta là người La Mã không được phép theo hay thực hành."
vi.R: Các chủ của cô gái thấy cô không còn kiếm tiền cho họ được nữa. Vì vậy họ túm lấy Phao-lô và Si-la, kéo đến các nhà lãnh đạo thành ở quảng trường. \v 20 Họ đem hai người đến các quan chức đứng đầu thành và nói: "Những người này là người Do Thái, và họ đang gây rối loạn trong thành chúng ta. \v 21 Họ dạy những tục lệ mà người La Mã chúng ta không được phép chấp nhận hay làm theo."

ko.L: 그런데 그 여자의 주인들은 자기들의 돈벌이의 희망이 나가 버린 것을 보고, 바울과 실라를 붙잡아 장터로 관원들에게 끌고 갔다. \v 20 그리고 그들을 행정관들 앞에 데리고 가서 말했다. "이 사람들은 유대인인데, 우리 도시를 몹시 소란하게 하고 있습니다. \v 21 그리고 로마 사람인 우리가 받아들일 수도 없고 행할 수도 없는 풍습을 선전하고 있습니다."
ko.B: 그 여자의 주인들은 영과 함께 자기들의 돈벌이 희망도 나가 버린 것을 알았다. 그래서 바울과 실라를 붙잡아 장터에 있는 관원들에게 끌고 갔다. \v 20 그들은 두 사람을 행정관들 앞에 세우고 말했다. "이 사람들은 우리 도시를 온통 소란하게 하고 있습니다. 이들은 유대인인데, \v 21 로마 사람인 우리가 받아들일 수도 없고 따를 수도 없는 풍습을 퍼뜨리고 있습니다."
ko.R: 그 여자의 주인들은 이제 그 여자를 통해 돈을 벌 수 없게 된 것을 알았다. 그래서 바울과 실라를 붙잡아 장터에 있는 도시 지도자들에게 끌고 갔다. \v 20 그들은 두 사람을 도시의 높은 관리들 앞에 데려가서 말했다. "이 사람들은 유대인입니다. 그런데 우리 도시에 큰 소란을 일으키고 있습니다. \v 21 이들은 로마 사람인 우리가 받아들여서도 안 되고 따라서도 안 되는 풍습을 가르치고 있습니다."

pt.L: Mas os senhores dela, vendo que a esperança do seu lucro tinha saído, agarraram Paulo e Silas e [os] arrastaram até a praça, diante das autoridades, \v 20 e, apresentando-os aos magistrados, disseram: "Estes homens estão perturbando a nossa cidade, sendo judeus, \v 21 e anunciam costumes que não nos é lícito aceitar nem praticar, sendo romanos."
pt.B: Os donos dela viram que a esperança de lucro tinha saído dela junto com o espírito. Por isso agarraram Paulo e Silas e os arrastaram até a praça, diante das autoridades. \v 20 Apresentando-os aos magistrados, disseram: "Estes homens estão perturbando toda a nossa cidade. São judeus \v 21 e pregam costumes que nós, sendo romanos, não temos permissão legal de adotar nem de praticar."
pt.R: Os donos da moça viram que ela não podia mais ganhar dinheiro para eles. Então agarraram Paulo e Silas e os arrastaram até as autoridades da cidade, na praça. \v 20 Levaram os dois aos principais oficiais da cidade e disseram: "Estes homens são judeus e estão causando muita confusão na nossa cidade. \v 21 Eles estão ensinando costumes que nós, romanos, não temos permissão de aceitar nem de seguir."

am.L: ጌቶቿም የትርፋቸው ተስፋ እንደ ወጣ ባዩ ጊዜ ጳውሎስንና ሲላስን ይዘው ወደ ገበያ ስፍራ ወደ ባለ ሥልጣናት ጎተቱአቸው፤ \v 20 ወደ ገዢዎቹም አቅርበዋቸው እንዲህ አሉ፦ «እነዚህ ሰዎች አይሁድ ሆነው ከተማችንን ያውካሉ፤ \v 21 እኛም ሮማውያን ሆነን ልንቀበላቸውም ሆነ ልናደርጋቸው የማይገቡንን ልማዶች ያውጃሉ።»
am.B: ጌቶቿም የትርፋቸው ተስፋ ከመንፈሱ ጋር ከእርሷ እንደ ወጣ አዩ። ስለዚህ ጳውሎስንና ሲላስን ይዘው በገበያው ስፍራ ወዳሉት ባለ ሥልጣናት ጎትተው ወሰዱአቸው። \v 20 ወደ ገዢዎቹም አቅርበዋቸው እንዲህ አሉ፦ «እነዚህ ሰዎች ከተማችንን በሙሉ እያወኩ ነው። አይሁድ ናቸው፤ \v 21 እኛ ሮማውያን ስለ ሆንን ልንቀበላቸውና ልንከተላቸው በሕግ የማይፈቀድልንን ልማዶች ይሰብካሉ።»
am.R: የልጅቷ ጌቶች ከእንግዲህ ገንዘብ ልታስገኝላቸው እንደማትችል አዩ። ስለዚህ ጳውሎስንና ሲላስን ይዘው በገበያው ስፍራ ወዳሉት የከተማዪቱ መሪዎች ጎተቱአቸው። \v 20 ወደ ከተማዪቱ ዋና ባለ ሥልጣናትም አምጥተዋቸው እንዲህ አሉ፦ «እነዚህ ሰዎች አይሁድ ናቸው፤ በከተማችንም ብዙ ሁከት እየፈጠሩ ነው። \v 21 እኛ ሮማውያን ልንቀበላቸውም ሆነ ልንከተላቸው የማይፈቀድልንን ልማዶች ያስተምራሉ።»

hi.L: पर जब उसके स्वामियों ने देखा कि उनकी कमाई की आशा जाती रही, तो वे पौलुस और सीलास को पकड़कर चौक में शासकों के पास घसीट ले गए, \v 20 और उन्हें हाकिमों के सामने लाकर कहा, "ये लोग, जो यहूदी हैं, हमारे नगर में बड़ी गड़बड़ी फैला रहे हैं, \v 21 और ऐसी रीतियाँ बताते हैं जिन्हें ग्रहण करना या मानना हम रोमियों के लिए उचित नहीं।"
hi.B: उसके स्वामियों ने देखा कि उस आत्मा के साथ उनकी कमाई की आशा भी निकल गई है। इसलिए उन्होंने पौलुस और सीलास को पकड़ लिया और उन्हें घसीटकर चौक में शासकों के पास ले गए। \v 20 उन्हें हाकिमों के सामने लाकर उन्होंने कहा, "ये लोग हमारे पूरे नगर में हलचल मचा रहे हैं। ये यहूदी हैं, \v 21 और ऐसी रीतियाँ सिखाते हैं जिन्हें अपनाना या मानना हमारे लिए नियम के विरुद्ध है, क्योंकि हम रोमी हैं।"
hi.R: उस दासी के मालिकों ने देखा कि अब वह उनके लिए पैसा नहीं कमा सकती। इसलिए उन्होंने पौलुस और सीलास को पकड़ लिया और घसीटकर चौक में शहर के अधिकारियों के पास ले गए। \v 20 वे उन्हें शहर के सबसे बड़े अधिकारियों के सामने लाए और बोले, "ये लोग यहूदी हैं, और हमारे शहर में बहुत गड़बड़ कर रहे हैं। \v 21 ये ऐसी रीतियाँ सिखा रहे हैं जिन्हें मानने या अपनाने की हम रोमियों को इजाज़त नहीं है।"

ru.L: Увидев же её господа, что вышла надежда их дохода, схватив Павла и Силу, потащили [их] на площадь к начальникам \v 20 и, приведя их к магистратам, сказали: «Эти люди возмущают наш город, будучи иудеями, \v 21 и проповедуют обычаи, которые не позволено нам ни принимать, ни исполнять, будучи римлянами.»
ru.B: Хозяева рабыни увидели, что вместе с духом из неё вышла и их надежда на доход. Тогда они схватили Павла и Силу и потащили их на площадь к начальникам. \v 20 Приведя их к магистратам, они сказали: «Эти люди возмущают весь наш город. Они иудеи \v 21 и проповедуют обычаи, которые нам, римлянам, нельзя по закону ни принимать, ни соблюдать.»
ru.R: Хозяева девушки увидели, что она больше не сможет приносить им деньги. Тогда они схватили Павла и Силу и потащили их на площадь к городским властям. \v 20 Они привели их к главным начальникам города и сказали: «Эти люди — иудеи, и они устраивают большие беспорядки в нашем городе. \v 21 Они учат обычаям, которые нам, римлянам, нельзя принимать и соблюдать.»

uk.L: Побачивши ж її пани, що вийшла надія їхнього прибутку, схопили Павла і Силу й потягли на ринкову площу до начальників, \v 20 і, привівши їх до стратегів, сказали: «Ці люди, будучи юдеями, збурюють наше місто \v 21 і проповідують звичаї, яких нам не годиться ні приймати, ні виконувати, бувши римлянами.»
uk.B: Її пани побачили, що разом із духом вийшла й їхня надія на прибуток. Тож вони схопили Павла і Силу й потягли їх на ринкову площу до правителів. \v 20 Привівши їх до міських урядовців, вони сказали: «Ці люди бунтують усе наше місто. Вони юдеї \v 21 і проповідують звичаї, яких ми, римляни, не маємо права ні приймати, ні виконувати.»
uk.R: Власники дівчини побачили, що вона більше не зможе заробляти для них грошей. Тож вони схопили Павла і Силу й потягли їх на ринкову площу до міських начальників. \v 20 Вони привели їх до найвищих урядовців міста й сказали: «Ці люди — юдеї, і вони наробили великого безладу в нашому місті. \v 21 Вони навчають звичаїв, яких нам, римлянам, не дозволено ні приймати, ні виконувати.»

ja.L: しかし、彼女の主人たちは、自分たちの利益の望みが出て行ってしまったのを見て、パウロとシラスを捕らえ、広場へ、役人たちの前に引きずって行った。\v 20 そして彼らを長官たちのところに連れて行って言った。「この者たちはユダヤ人で、わたしたちの町をひどく混乱させています。\v 21 そして、ローマ人であるわたしたちが受け入れることも行うことも許されていない慣習を、告げ伝えているのです。」
ja.B: 少女の主人たちは、金もうけの望みが霊と一緒に出て行ってしまったのを見て、パウロとシラスを捕らえ、広場にいる役人たちのところへ引きずって行った。\v 20 そして二人を長官たちの前に引き出して言った。「この者たちは、わたしたちの町をすっかり混乱させています。ユダヤ人なのです。\v 21 そして、ローマ人であるわたしたちが受け入れることも行うことも許されていない風習を、告げ伝えているのです。」
ja.R: 少女の持ち主たちは、もう少女を使ってお金をもうけられなくなったことに気づきました。そこで、パウロとシラスを捕まえて、広場にいる町の指導者たちのところへ引きずって行きました。\v 20 二人を町の長官たちの前に連れて行って、言いました。「この者たちはユダヤ人で、わたしたちの町をひどく騒がせています。\v 21 わたしたちローマ人が受け入れることも、行うことも許されていない習慣を伝えているのです。」

decisions.choice: gone out: the same verb as for the spirit coming out
decisions.reason: The spirit "came out" (16:18) and the owners' hope of profit "went out" with it. The repeated verb makes a grim joke.

decisions.choice: rulers and magistrates: the same men, the chief officials of the colony
decisions.reason: "Rulers" is a general word for those in authority. "Magistrates" renders the Greek word for generals, which was used in Greek cities for the two chief officials who ran a Roman colony, known in Latin as duumvirs or praetors. Luke uses the word only of these officials from here on (16:22, 35, 36, 38).

decisions.choice: the marketplace: the forum, the city's public square
decisions.reason: The forum held the courts and offices of the city's officials. The foundations of the forum of Roman Philippi can still be seen.

decisions.choice: being Jews: an appeal to feeling against Jews
decisions.reason: The owners say nothing of their lost income. They set "Jews" against "Romans" (16:21). About this time the emperor Claudius ordered Jews out of Rome (18:2).

decisions.choice: customs not lawful for Romans: foreign religious ways that Romans should not take up
decisions.reason: Romans held that citizens should not adopt foreign cults that were not approved. The charge is vague, but it was serious in a colony that prided itself on being Roman.

decisions.choice: out of her along with the spirit
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the wordplay of the meaning note by saying what went out with what.

decisions.choice: the chief officials of the city
decisions.reason: Readable describes the office instead of naming it, as the meaning note explains.

decisions.choice: she could no longer make money for them
alternatives: the hope of their profit had gone out
decisions.reason: Readable says what the loss was; the wordplay cannot be kept in plain words.

decisions.choice: las autoridades, los magistrados (L, B); los jefes de la ciudad, los principales funcionarios de la ciudad (R)
decisions.reason: Two words for the same chief officials of the colony (meaning decision m2). "Magistrados" is used for the second word through the rest of the chapter; "pretores", the Latin title, would need explaining. Readable says who they were, as the English does.

decisions.choice: les magistrats
decisions.reason: The Greek title stands for the two chief officials of a Roman colony (m2). "Les magistrats" is the plain French for such officials; "préteurs" is the Latin title and "stratèges" would suggest generals.

decisions.choice: watawala, mahakimu (L, B); viongozi wa mji, maafisa wakuu wa mji (R)
decisions.reason: Two words for the same chief officials of the colony (meaning decision m2). "Mahakimu" (magistrates) is used for the second word through the rest of the chapter, since these men also sat in judgment; Readable says who they were, as the English does.

decisions.choice: limetoka (L, B), as the spirit "akamtoka" (verse 18)
decisions.reason: Luke uses the same verb for the hope of profit going out as for the spirit coming out (meaning decision m1). Literal and Balanced keep "kutoka" so the play on words can still be heard; Readable says what it meant.

decisions.choice: "các quan tòa" (L, B); "các quan chức đứng đầu thành" (R) for the magistrates (16:20-38)
decisions.reason: The chief officials of the colony, who also judged (meaning decision); "quan tòa" names their part in this scene.

decisions.choice: inclusive "chúng ta" for the accusers and the magistrates
decisions.reason: The accusers speak as fellow citizens of the officials they address, so the inclusive form.

decisions.choice: "관원들" (L, B), "도시 지도자들" (R) for the rulers; "행정관들" (L, B), "도시의 높은 관리들", "도시 관리들" (R) for the magistrates (stratēgoi), through Acts 16
decisions.reason: The two words name the chief officials of the colony (meaning decision, uncertain). Korean keeps two words where the Greek has two; "행정관" says what the magistrates of a Roman colony were, and Readable uses plain words, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "희망이 나가 버린" (L); "영과 함께 자기들의 돈벌이 희망도 나가 버린" (B)
decisions.reason: The same verb is used for the spirit coming out (meaning decision); "나가다" keeps the link at Literal and Balanced, as the English does.

decisions.choice: os magistrados (L, B); os principais oficiais da cidade (R)
decisions.reason: For Acts 16, the two chief officials of the Roman colony (m2) are "os magistrados", the Portuguese word for civic officials with judicial power; "pretores" is the Latin title and would need explaining. Readable describes the office, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: a praça
decisions.reason: The marketplace was the city's public square, where the officials sat (m3); Portuguese "praça" says that, where "mercado" would suggest a market hall.
